fact: The Kenya Bureau of Standards (KEBS), led by director general Esther Ngari and overseen by a National Standards Council chaired by Dr Chris Wamalwa, was in operation in August 2026; the article does not say what law set it up and names no IT or data standard.

The release says the Kenya Bureau of Standards has existed since 1974 and provides standards development, metrology, conformity assessment, training and certification services; it names no IT or data standard issued by it and no law.

The ICT Authority's Government Data Centre Standard (ICTA.2.002:2019) says the Kenya Bureau of Standards (KEBS) is the source of information on valid national and international standards and took part in developing the ICTA standards under a memorandum of understanding; the document gives no date for KEBS's creation or its legal basis, and its date is the document's board approval.
The Kenya Bureau of Standards was established by the Standards Act, Chapter 496, and started operations in July 1974, per ISO's member page.
